Definition: from G2596 and G3062; left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the rest):--residue.
BiblicalUsage: The residue of men shall seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles upon whom His name is called.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the remnant was never only Israel, because God always meant the nations to seek Him too.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
